data.one_liner: A Flutter package containing a collection of animated buttons with customizable transitions.
data.what_it_does: Provides ready-to-use animated button widgets (`AnimatedButton` and `AnimatedButton.strip`) that support various transition types, border configurations, text styles, and hover/tap animations.
use_when: You need custom animated buttons with entrance and transition effects upon tap or hover.
You want to quickly add styled buttons with distinct background and text color transformations.
avoid_when: You need standard Material design buttons without custom animated background reveals.
Your design system calls for complex bespoke animations not covered by the pre-configured transition types.
strengths: Provides numerous built-in transition types and rounder shapes.
Supports null safety and web, desktop, and mobile platforms.
Easy customization of colors, borders, and text styles.
weaknesses: Limited to button animations specifically supplied by the package.
Not a general-purpose animation library for arbitrary widgets.
data.minimal_example:
AnimatedButton(
  width: 200,
  text: 'SUBMIT',
  selectedTextColor: Colors.black,
  transitionType: TransitionType.BOTTOM_TO_TOP,
  textStyle: TextStyle(
    fontSize: 28,
    letterSpacing: 5,
    color: Colors.deepOrange,
    fontWeight: FontWeight.w300,
  ),
)
